intro: Papua New Guinea has around 10 million or more people, most living in rural villages.

chapters.title: People
text: Tok Pisin, Hiri Motu and English are official, along with sign language, but about 840 languages are spoken. Most people are Christian, and many follow traditional customs.

chapters.title: Village life
text: Over 80% live in rural areas, growing sweet potatoes, taro and bananas.
